description: HIV-1 protease drug resistance benchmark — initial frozen version. Contains cases with exact Ki values and literature-derived mechanism labels from Mahalingam et al. 2004 (PMID 15066177).
split_note: With only 2 calibration-ready cases, no held-out split is defined. When ≥10 cases with mechanism labels are available, cases will be split at the mutation level (same mutation's WT/mutant structures go to the same split).

cases.assay_conditions: pH 5.0, 25°C, 0.1 M sodium acetate, 1 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl
cases.source_table_or_figure: Results section, Ki values reported in text
cases.notes: WT error ±70 pM, V82A error ±270 pM. V82A is an active-site mutation contacting indinavir directly. Loss of ~0.79 kcal/mol binding energy.
cases.mechanism_label: 侧链体积减小导致S1口袋疏水堆积减弱，失去与吲地那韦的直接范德华接触

cases.assay_conditions: pH 5.0, 25°C, 0.1 M sodium acetate, 1 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl
cases.source_table_or_figure: Results section, Ki values reported in text
cases.notes: WT error ±70 pM, L90M error ±8 pM. L90M is a non-active-site mutation at the dimer interface. Paradoxically enhances indinavir binding ~6-fold. Catalytic efficiency retained at ~81-85% of WT.
cases.mechanism_label: 二聚体界面非活性位点突变，L90M增强与吲地那韦的疏水相互作用，导致Ki降低
